homeAffairs.identityVerificationDesc: Provisional accounts without a matching Home Affairs record — review and verify, or enrol as a new identity.

birthRegistrationForm.title: Register a birth
birthRegistrationForm.parentInfoReused: Your verified information as parent/guardian has been reused from your Home Affairs record — you do not need to re-enter it.
birthRegistrationForm.informantHelp: The informant is the person reporting this birth to Home Affairs — usually a parent, but can be another relative or responsible adult.
birthRegistrationForm.informantCapacityHelp: For example: Mother, Father, Grandparent, Guardian.

birthCertificateView.title: Birth Certificate
birthCertificateView.notCollectedWarning: This certificate has not yet been collected. Please visit the office shown above with valid identification.
birthCertificateView.demoNotice: Demo document — for prototype/testing purposes only. Not a legal record.
birthCertificateView.emblemAlt: Simplified national emblem (stylised, not an official reproduction)
birthCertificateView.certifiedStatement: This certifies that the particulars above are recorded as an entry in the Register of Births maintained by the Ministry of Home Affairs.
birthCertificateView.systemReference: System reference (not part of the printed certificate)

nationalIdCardView.demoNotice: Demo document — for prototype/testing purposes only. Not a legal identity document.

nationalIdForm.title: Apply for a National ID card
nationalIdForm.eligibleNotice: You are eligible to apply for a National ID card.
nationalIdForm.reuseNotice: Your name, date of birth, sex, place of birth and permanent identity number are reused from your verified Home Affairs record.
nationalIdForm.noNewNumberNotice: Your existing permanent identity number will be used. A new number is never issued.

correctionForm.title: Report an error in your civil record

identityVerificationForm.title: Submit your identity for verification
identityVerificationForm.intro: A Home Affairs officer will review the details you provide here against the civil register, then verify your identity or enrol you as a new identity if you have never been registered before.
identityVerificationForm.haveExistingIdQuestion: Do you already have a permanent identity number?
identityVerificationForm.noNeedEnrolment: No, I have never been registered
identityVerificationForm.submitted: Submitted — reference {{reference}}. A Home Affairs officer will review it.
identityVerificationForm.pendingNotice: Your request {{reference}} is awaiting review by a Home Affairs officer.
identityVerificationForm.rejectedNotice: Your last request was not approved: {{reason}}
identityVerificationForm.rejectedRetry: You can submit a new request below with corrected details.
identityVerificationForm.verifiedNotice: Your identity has been verified. You now have full access to citizen services.

identityVerificationQueue.title: Identity Verification Requests
identityVerificationQueue.desc: Review provisional accounts, compare their stated details against the civil register, and verify or reject each request.
identityVerificationQueue.noExistingId: New identity enrolment — states they have never been registered
identityVerificationQueue.noMatchFound: No citizen record matches that identity number
identityVerificationQueue.detailsMismatch: ID number found, but details differ
identityVerificationQueue.detailsMismatchExplain: The identity number exists on file, but the date of birth and/or name marked ⚠ above do not match what the applicant stated. This could be a typo, a name change, or someone using a number that isn't theirs — check with the applicant before linking.
identityVerificationQueue.empty: No identity verification requests waiting for review.

marriageForm.title: Register a Marriage
marriageForm.filerInfoReused: Your own verified identity is used automatically as one spouse's particulars — you don't need to re-enter it.
marriageForm.spousePermanentIdHelp: If your spouse already has a national identity number, entering it helps link the records. Leave blank if not known.
marriageForm.certifyIntro: is to certify that the marriage described above was registered in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Lesotho.
marriageForm.certifiedStatement: This certifies that the marriage described above was registered in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Lesotho.

divorceForm.title: Register a Divorce
divorceForm.courtNotice: A Lesotho court grants a divorce — Home Affairs registers it against that court order. You will need the court order reference.
divorceForm.marriageReferenceHelp: If the marriage was registered in this system, enter its certificate number. Otherwise, leave blank.
divorceForm.divorceOrderDate: Date the court granted the divorce
divorceForm.certifiedStatement: This certifies that the divorce described above, granted by the court named, has been registered in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Lesotho.

deathForm.intro: Anyone can report a death for registration. You will need the deceased’s permanent identity number.
deathForm.deceasedPermanentIdHelp: This is the deceased's own national identity number, on their National ID card.
deathForm.submitted: Death registration for {{name}} has been submitted and is awaiting review.
deathForm.officerIntro: Review and approve death registrations. Approving marks the citizen record as deceased.

passport.title: Passport Services
passport.reuseNotice: Your verified Home Affairs identity information will be reused for this application.

police.title: Police
police.purposeHelp: Every lookup must state a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
police.auditNotice: This lookup will be recorded in the audit log with your officer ID, the reason given, and the outcome.

clearance.title: Police Clearance Certificate
clearance.applyIntro: A Police Clearance Certificate confirms whether there is a record against your name, for use with an employer, a school, or an immigration authority.
clearance.officerNotes: Internal notes (not printed on the certificate)
clearance.certifyIntro: This is to certify that a search of police records has been conducted in respect of the person named below, with the following result:
clearance.resultStatementClean: No record of a pending criminal case was found against this person as at the date of issue.
clearance.resultStatementFound: A record was found against this person. Please contact the issuing office for further detail.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.bookInterpreterAppointment: Need an interpreter or other support arranged for a visit? Book an appointment →

admin.tempPasswordNotice: A temporary password is generated automatically. The new employee must change it the first time they log in.
admin.accountCreatedHelp: Share this temporary password with them securely — it will not be shown again.
admin.manageOfficesDesc: Open new branch offices for any department and assign them to a district.
admin.officesFormRequired: Department, district and branch name are required.
admin.officeCodeHelp: Optional short unique code, e.g. HA-MSU-01
admin.noOfficesYet: No branch offices have been created yet. Use the form above to open the first one.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.applyIntro: Use this if a service needs you to visit in person — for identity enrolment, biometric capture, collecting a document, or a physical verification. If you’d like a sign-language interpreter or another accommodation arranged ahead of your visit, you can add that below; it’s entirely optional and available to anyone.
appointments.purposeHelp: Choose whichever this visit is for.
appointments.needsInterpreterLabel: I would like a sign-language interpreter arranged for this visit
appointments.needsInterpreterHelp: The office will arrange this ahead of your visit rather than you finding out when you arrive.
appointments.accommodationNotes: Anything else we should arrange ahead of your visit (optional)
appointments.accommodationNotesHelp: For example, a support person accompanying you, or a ground-floor room.
